name: Twisted Judge (Rogue 1/Cleric 6)
body:
Twisted Judge
CR 6

XP 2,400
Male elf rogue 1/cleric 6
NE Medium humanoid (elf)
Init +6; Senses low-light vision; Perception +8

DEFENSES

AC 23, touch 19, flat-footed 17 (+4 armor, +3 deflection, +6 Dex)
hp 42 (7d8+7)
Fort +6, Ref +10, Will +7; +2 vs. enchantment
Immune sleep effects

OFFENSE
Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 war razor +11 (1d4/18–20)
Special Attacks channel negative energy (4/day, 3d6, DC 14), copycat (5/day), dazing touch (5/day), sneak attack +1d6
Spells Prepared (CL 6th)

3rd— bestow curse (DC 15), cure serious wounds, suggestion D (DC 15)
2nd— bear’s endurance, cat’s grace, cure moderate wounds, invisibility D, undetectable alignment
1st— charm person D (DC 13), command (DC 13), cure light wounds,
divine favor, shield of faith
0th— light, mending, read magic, virtue

D domain spell ( Charm, Trickery) (already cast)
STATISTICS
Str 8, Dex 22, Con 12, Int 15, Wis 14, Cha 12
Base Atk +4; CMB +3; CMD 22
Feats Channel Smite, Combat Reflexes, Martial Weapon Proficiency ( war razor), Weapon Finesse
Skills Bluff +11, Diplomacy +11, Intimidate +11, Linguistics +6, Knowledge (local) +6, Knowledge (religion) +11, Perception +8, Spellcraft +9, Stealth +10
SQ spontaneous casting (inflict spells), trapfinding +1
Languages Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elven, Infernal
Combat Gear wand of cure moderate wounds (12 charges); Other Gear mithral shirt, +1 war razor, reaper’s mask
